headline: Winter without power: Kyiv allows for electricity outages of 20 hours a day
summary: In the worst-case scenario, Kyiv residents could face up to 20 hours a day without electricity, according to Ekonomichna Pravda. The forecast considers new strikes on infrastructure during severe frosts.
why: Energy infrastructure damage affects industrial output, power prices and the operating conditions for businesses in Ukraine.
